watches.name: CATHEDRAL
watches.description: The Cathedral We see Lincoln Cathedral every day. I(http://day.It)t (http://day.It)is one of those things you can get used to, until the light changes and you suddenly notice it again. That was what caught us in Dominic Parczuk's (https://www.dominicparczuk.com)painting. He had taken the Cathedral and painted it in the evening, with the sky already dark and the last of the light sitting around Castle Square. The Cathedral itself is warm against that deep blue sky, and there is something about the whole scene that feels very familiar to us. It feels like Lincoln in the winter. The days are shorter. You leave the workshop and it is already getting dark. The streets are quieter, the sky is deep blue, and then you see the Cathedral above you, still lit up. There is something comforting about that. We have lived and worked here for a long time, and the Cathedral has always been part of the view. You might walk past it without really thinking about it, then catch sight of it from a different street or see it lit up on your way home. It is a reminder that some things stay where they are. They have been there for generations, and they will still be there when we are gone. That feeling was what we wanted to bring into the Cathedral watch. Dominic’s painting sits on the back of the watch, so when you turn it over you see the Cathedral as he saw it that evening, glowing above the city. On the front, Jason has taken some of the feeling from the Cathedral’s stained glass and brought it into the dial. It (http://dial.It)is not just a picture of the place where we happen to work, It (http://work.It)is a little piece of home. And perhaps that is what we like most about it. A watch leaves the workshop with someone and goes on to become part of their life. This one carries a small part of ours with it too. The Cathedral will still be standing above Lincoln tonight. We will probably see it on our way home.

watches.name: NOVUM
watches.description: Beautiful Simplicity A British handmade watch to wear every day. If you prefer a classic, slightly smaller, watch than many that are available today, you are not alone. The Novum might be just right for you. Many men, and quite a few ladies, are very comfortable with its 36mm diameter, and we at Harold Pinchbeck have always found a steady and loyal demand for this size. This latest Pinchbeck watch, the Novum, is a fresh perspective on a former favourite. Practical for daily use, it’s smart enough for special occasions, and beautiful in its simplicity. This lovely timepiece has a beautifully finished 316L stainless steel case, a sapphire crystal for scratch resistance and a clear (exhibition) caseback to reveal the fine Swiss movement, the ETA 2824-2, which is kept wound by the natural movement of your wrist. Its 3ATM water resistance is enhanced by a screwdown winding crown, and the leather strap is handcrafted in Devon by Tanner Bates. Assembled to order in our English workshop, the Novum can be on your wrist within a few weeks. It will be worth the short wait!

watches.name: INFINITY
watches.description: The Infinity began with a pattern we first explored a few years ago. At its centre is a brass dial with a continuous design CNC cut directly into the surface, creating a repeating pattern with no obvious beginning or end. As the light moves across the dial, the cut lines catch it differently, giving the brass a changing texture and depth. We have brought the design back with the same idea at its centre, pairing the detailed dial with a clean white chapter ring, Roman numerals and blue hands. The result is a distinctive British watch with a traditional feel and a more contemporary approach to the dial. As with our other watches, the Infinity is assembled in our Lincoln workshop and made to order, one watch at a time.

watches.name: LAMBETH DARK
watches.description: A Pinchbeck watch that celebrates the historic London River Race. Limited edition of 270 Introducing the Lambeth Dark, a striking black version of our celebrated Pinchbeck Lambeth Reach watch. This addition showcases the meticulous craftsmanship and elegance of the Pinchbeck brand in a bold hue. The sleek black dial boasts visually striking colours of Tan and Pewter-Blue, while its intricate design underscores artisanal quality. With Swiss movement for precision and reliability, the watch combines style and practicality. The fine leather hand-made Tanner Bates watch strap in black leather, with tan stitch, complements its aesthetic while ensuring comfort and durability. Ideal for the modern gentleman, the Lambeth Dark melds heritage with contemporary flair, making it suitable for both professional and casual settings. Elevate your collection with this embodiment of timeless British craftsmanship and sophistication. is a particularly stylish watch, its appeal enhanced by the fact that only 270 will ever be made. It is an ideal and practical timepiece, not only for followers of the Doggett’s Race, but for anyone interested in the history of the City of London and its intriguing traditions. The Lambeth’s contemporary 41mm case is a happy marriage with the traditional dial and hands. The symbology on its dial includes the Hanover Horse, and reflects the Race’s rich heritage through its connections with the Fishmongers’ Company and the Company of Watermen and Lightermen. The Lambeth Reach is powered by one of the world’s most respected Swiss-made mechanical movements, the superb ETA 2824-2. Its design and meticulous engineering have been proved and refined over several decades, and it is respected by good watchmakers everywhere. Kept wound by wrist movement, it can also be hand wound. We deal direct with you, our valued Customer, so that we can provide the best possible service. Every Harold Pinchbeck watch is individually assembled: not - like most watches - in a large factory, but by hand, in an English workshop. It’s then inspected and tested thoroughly before being beautifully packaged and despatched to its owner.

watches.name: LINDUM AUREATE
watches.description: From Ancient Lindum to Modern Mastery Named after the Roman moniker for our home city of Lincoln, the Harold Pinchbeck Lindum is a tribute to our heritage. Picture this: meticulously hand-assembled in a 14th Century building just steps away from the majestic Cathedral and a stone's throw from the heart of the city's Roman centre. While the Lindum resonates with tradition, it embodies the finest modern craftsmanship. Witness the precision-machined solid brass dial, capturing the intricate tracery of the Cathedral's renowned Bishop's Eye window. Choose from two dial finishes - Parchment or Aureate (gold coloured). The caseback showcases the Dean's Eye window, the perfect companion to its historic counterpart; alternatively you can opt for an exhibition back to display the intricate mechanism of the Swiss-made automatic movement. This isn't just a timepiece; it's a work of art destined for collectors and connoisseurs alike. Only 100 Lindum watches will be crafted, each uniquely numbered on the caseback, and validated with a personally-signed certificate. The Lindum, a successor to our coveted Lincoln watch, shares the Harold Pinchbeck family connection but stands out in its own right. The Lincoln's success, with all 50 pieces swiftly finding their forever homes, inspired us to bring you this stunning sequel. Whether it's for everyday elegance or those special moments, the Pinchbeck Lindum is a story just waiting to unfold. Don't miss your chance to own this small part of history—secure your LINDUM today!

watches.name: ALBION BLUE
watches.description: Precision, Heritage, and the Colour of Depth Limited-edition: 50 pieces Introducing the Albion Blue, a refined evolution of our much-loved Albion. Retaining the striking Union Jack dial, this new design reimagines the patriotic motif in deep navy blue, echoing the craftsmanship, confidence, and quiet strength of British watchmaking. Choose between a handmade English leather strap in navy for a classic, understated look, or yellow ochre for a bolder statement, both crafted by Tanner Bates of Devon.

watches.name: Watchmaker's Special Green & Orange
watches.description: Watchmaker's Special | Green & Orange A Watchmaker's Special begins with an idea. This one began with a colour. For some time, we'd wanted to work with orange. It appeared in conversations around the workshop, but we hadn't yet found the right watch for it. The answer was a deep green Harold Pinchbeck dial, hand-painted orange hour and minute hands, and a Tanner Bates hand-cut leather strap finished with contrasting orange stitching. Rob carefully colour-matched the hands to the stitching, bringing the whole watch together. The result is bold, balanced and unmistakably different. As with every Watchmaker's Special, this watch sits outside our regular collection. It was created simply because we wanted to explore an idea. It is now ready to find its owner. watches.name: SIGMA
watches.description: A Playful Sum of Style Precision, Playfulness, and a Luminous Twist The Sigma is where practicality meets personality. Named after the Greek letter Σ (Sigma), a symbol of sum and completeness, it brings together the elements that make everyday wear delightful: colour, function, and craftsmanship. Beyond its mathematical roots, “Sigma” has become a mark of precision, sophistication, and innovation, a subtle nod to something distinctive and elevated. That spirit is reflected in the Sigma’s luminous markers and hands, which glow in the dark, giving this small 36mm watch a signature personality that is both playful and uniquely recognisable. The teal blue dial with soft peach markers adds a cheerful touch, while the off-white seconds hand provides a quiet contrast. Paired with a Tanner Bates conker leather strap, the Sigma blends Pinchbeck’s British heritage with contemporary design, making it a practical daytime companion and a collectible for the long term. Designed as a partner to the Novum, Sigma will grow with the collection, each edition adding a new color story. Lighthearted, thoughtful, and unmistakably Pinchbeck, the Sigma proves that everyday elegance can be joyful and luminous in its own way.

watches.name: Watchmaker's Special Burgundy & Blue
watches.description: The Burgundy & Blue This Watchmaker’s Special began with a burgundy dial and an idea from Rob. The dial carries the Harold Pinchbeck name, a nod to the family watch and clock repair shop opened by Harold Pinchbeck in the early 20th century. Rob wanted to bring something unexpected to it. He hand-painted the hour and minute hands in light blue, choosing a colour that stands clearly against the deep burgundy dial. The same pairing continues beyond the watch. Rob worked with Tanner Bates in Devon to create a burgundy leather strap, hand-cut and hand-stitched with contrasting blue thread. Then, for the first time on a Watchmaker’s Special, we commissioned a leather watch wallet specifically to match. The watch, strap and wallet were conceived as one piece. Inside is an ETA 2824-2 Swiss automatic movement, assembled, regulated and tested by Rob in our Lincoln workshop. The Burgundy & Blue sits outside our regular collection. It wasn’t designed for ongoing production or added to a catalogue. Rob made it because the combination felt worth making. We may return to the idea again one day. For now, this is the one he made. This collectors’ timepiece embodies the essence of British watchmaking heritage, clearly inspired by the vivid colours of the Union Jack. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Albion is an English luxury watch, displaying the iconic flag that is so loved and synonymous with Great Britain. The robust 41mm stainless steel case not only ensures durability but also enhances the watch’s sophisticated appearance, making it suitable for both casual and formal occasions. An impeccable fusion of style and functionality, the Pinchbeck Albion is equipped with a precise automatic Swiss movement for accurate timekeeping. The supremely comfortable Tanner Bates hand-made leather strap offers a plush fit on the wrist, ensuring that wearers can enjoy this statement piece throughout the day. Whether marking a special occasion or looking to make a bold fashion statement, the Albion is a perfect accessory, celebrating your affinity for British culture. Don’t miss the opportunity to own this exclusive Harold Pinchbeck timepiece. Order yours today and wear your pride on your wrist!
